tspan.tspan: Choose the tool type and enter dimensions, material (materi
al type, diameter, surface finish) and machining conditions.
The estimated unit price is recalculated on every input.
Derives ¥/1000mm from purchase history of the same mater
ial type, diameter and surface finish, per the settings (lates
t / highest / average and look-back months). With no history
the material type's default price is used and a "Default pri
ce" badge appears.
For the cylinder tool type the reference price is not used; e
nter the material price (¥/pc) by hand.
If the market differs, re-enter the reference price with "Edit
price". A "Custom" badge appears; "Back to policy value"
restores the automatic price.
A name is required. It gets an EST- number and becomes "
Draft". The result at save time is recorded and the content
can no longer be edited.
Opens the form with the same content and "(redo)" added t
o the name. Saving creates a draft with a new number. Any
status can be duplicated.
Only estimates with a product can be chosen in a price list
. While Draft or Confirmed the link can be changed or remov
ed.
Only a Draft can be confirmed. It is recalculated with the cu
rrent settings, recorded, and becomes "Confirmed".
The regrind service holds a standard price (list price) on th
e regrind item. No price estimate is used. The standard pric
e cannot be changed from the price list screen.
One per customer × item, with base price, valid period and
quantity tiers per order type. Products take Production / Tes
t / Sample / Other, regrind items only Regrind. Test and Sam
ple need an end date.
The same customer × item already exists, so it cannot be s
aved. Open the existing price list and add order types or pri
ces by editing it.
The estimated unit price of a confirmed estimate for the sa
me product becomes the base price. An estimate used for t
he first time becomes "Registered" and its product link can
no longer change.
Enter the base price by hand with "Use custom price". The
estimate source shows "Manual". Custom prices can also
be set per tier.
Set a rate (%) or amount (¥/pc) with quantity and period con
ditions. If several match, the largest discount is used.
Three entry points: New, "Create quote" on a price list, or d
uplicating a quote. Choosing customer, item, order type and
quantity fills unit price, discount and amount automaticall
y (no manual entry).
From an active price list and active order type whose valid
period covers today, the tier matching the quantity gives t
he unit price (base price × multiplier, or custom) and the di
scount. A regrind item with no matching price list uses its
standard price.
A product line with no matching price list (missing, inactiv
e or out of period), or a price list without a tier for the quant
ity, cannot be saved. Prepare the estimate and price list, or
add the tier.
It gets a QOT- number and becomes "Draft". Unit price, disc
ount and tax are frozen at save time. A draft can be edited;
saving again re-reads the current price list.
Raising it from the quote's menu carries the quote over. It r
uns in parallel with the quote (not possible from an expired
quote).
A valid-until date is required and must be today or later. It b
ecomes "Issued"; after that it can be neither edited nor un-
issued.
The quote PDF is generated and stored on issue. Only issu
ed quotes have a PDF.
The quote is already issued. Regenerate from the PDF tab.
Download it from the PDF tab and send it by email or on pa
per. The "email to customer" checkbox in the issue dialog
does not send anything automatically.
Reviews the quote. There is no operation to record the repl
y on the quote.
When an order acceptance names this quote, it appears un
der "To" on the quote. The order flow starts here.
An issued quote past its valid-until date is shown as "Expi
red" automatically (not stored as a status).
An issued quote cannot be changed, so duplicate it into a
new draft and start again from step 15.

svg.text: Pricing and quotes — from price estimate to issuing the quote
